paper_title: Overview of the Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment (CASPEr)
notes: This is an overview/proposal paper presenting sensitivity projections (not measured limits) for CASPEr Electric (axion-gluon EDM coupling g_d) and CASPEr Wind (ALP-nucleon coupling g_aNN). Figs. 3 and 4 show projected reach but no numerical values are tabulated in the text — only a schematic plot. The paper covers two distinct couplings (AxionEDM/g_d for Electric and AxionNeutron/g_aNN for Wind via 129Xe which is neutron-rich), so coupling type is ambiguous and no extractable data points are available. Local DM density assumed ~0.4 GeV/cm^3. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionNeutron (2/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
